title: Sunday · Last Bell, with lockboxes
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The school at the last bell, and across the road the rental houses each with a key-safe on the doorframe, drawn in every tier, never mentioned. The man and the pup on the sidewalk between the school and the boxes.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the school at 3:05 from the road, the bell shape, students starting out; a rental house's doorframe at the tier's edge with a small gray key-safe.

image.prompt: a small-town high school at the last bell with students starting out and at the frame's edge a house doorframe with a small gray lockbox on it, watercolor

panels.name: Bell

panels.composition: Tier 2: three doorframes in a row across the road, each with a key-safe, blinds down.

image.prompt: three house doorframes in a row each with a small gray lockbox and blinds drawn, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Boxes

panels.composition: Tier 3: the man and the pup on the sidewalk, the students passing on one side, the lockboxed doors on the other.

image.prompt: a man and a small three-legged dog on a sidewalk between a crowd of passing students on one side and a row of locked-up houses on the other, watercolor

panels.name: Between

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Lockboxes in the backgrounds, never mentioned.
